titleEn: Minimum Difficulty of a Job Schedule
title: 工作计划的最低难度
summary: 工作必须按顺序在 d 天内完成且每天至少一项，当天难度为该日最大工作难度，求总难度最小值；工作不足返回负一。
insight: dp[day][jobs] 表示前 jobs 项分成 day 天的最低难度；枚举最后一天从 split 开始，逆向扩展并维护该段最大值，与前 day-1 天状态相加。
pitfalls: 最后一天难度是该段最大值而非和

solutions.title: 天数前缀分段动态规划
solutions.idea: 枚举最后一天起点并滚动维护区间最大难度。
steps: 若 n<d 返回 -1；dp[0]=0 其余无穷
day 从一到 d，新建 next；jobs 至少为 day，逆向枚举 split 从 jobs-1 到 day-1，维护 maximum

code.java: class Solution { public int minDifficulty(int[] jobDifficulty,int d){int n=jobDifficulty.length;if(n<d)return -1;int infinity=1000000000;int[] dp=new int[n+1];Arrays.fill(dp,infinity);dp[0]=0;for(int day=1;day<=d;day++){int[] next=new int[n+1];Arrays.fill(next,infinity);for(int jobs=day;jobs<=n;jobs++){int maximum=0;for(int split=jobs-1;split>=day-1;split--){maximum=Math.max(maximum,jobDifficulty[split]);next[jobs]=Math.min(next[jobs],dp[split]+maximum);}}dp=next;}return dp[n];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minDifficulty(jobDifficulty:IntArray,d:Int):Int{val n=jobDifficulty.size;if(n<d)return -1;val infinity=1000000000;var dp=IntArray(n+1){infinity};dp[0]=0;for(day in 1..d){val next=IntArray(n+1){infinity};for(jobs in day..n){var maximum=0;for(split in jobs-1 downTo day-1){maximum=maxOf(maximum,jobDifficulty[split]);next[jobs]=minOf(next[jobs],dp[split]+maximum)}};dp=next};return dp[n]} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minDifficulty(vector<int>& jobDifficulty,int d){int n=jobDifficulty.size();if(n<d)return -1;const int INF=1000000000;vector<int> dp(n+1,INF);dp[0]=0;for(int day=1;day<=d;++day){vector<int> next(n+1,INF);for(int jobs=day;jobs<=n;++jobs){int maximum=0;for(int split=jobs-1;split>=day-1;--split){maximum=max(maximum,jobDifficulty[split]);next[jobs]=min(next[jobs],dp[split]+maximum);}}dp.swap(next);}return dp[n];} };
